note_en: 不是…而是… means "not X but Y" and corrects an expected idea: 海底捞不是在卖火锅，而是在卖服务 "Haidilao isn't selling hot pot, it's selling service." 而是 introduces the true version; plain 是 can't replace it here, and English often just uses a comma or "but rather."
